additional_context: FHIR-28250 is the PA-side supporting decision: PA rejected broadening Encounter.reason and instead selected workflow-supportingInfo, creating FHIR-35850 to add Encounter context. reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because the current authoritative extension definition already includes Encounter, and reintroducing or editing the removed core spreadsheet row would be duplicate or out-of-build source.
